title: AIArchive — model preservation news
description: Captures, mirrors, takedown alerts and radar signals for open-weight AI models

items.title: This week aiarchive.info captured 170 open-weight model repos and mirrored 15, including new Baichuan, ByteDance-Seed, Qwen, and DeepSeek entries. Newly captured families span Qwen (Qwen3.5, Qwen3.6, Qwen-Image 2.1), DeepSeek (V4-Flash, V3.2-Speciale, OCR-2), MiniMax (M2.5 through M3), and Tencent (Hunyuan, Hy-MT2, WeVisDoc). No alerts were triggered; radar signals included HN front-page posts on Qwen Image 2.1 and small local models such as Cactus Needle 3.
